items.title: Apple Creator Studio update adds MotionVFX to Final Cut, and AI to everywhere
items.excerpt: Logic Pro gets a beta AI assistant built with OpenAI that can edit existing projects, start new songs and generate vocal tracks from text prompts; Stem Splitter can now isolate or swap drum parts.
items.rationale: Biggest workflow change in the pool: Logic Pro ships a beta AI assistant that edits projects and generates vocals from prompts, plus drum-part swapping in Stem Splitter. This is the release that follows the Samplab acquisition covered on 10-22.

items.title: Massive XL is here: Native Instruments supersizes its flagship soft synth with AI-powered preset generation, custom wavetables and much more
items.excerpt: 20 years after Massive, Native Instruments unveils Massive XL, which uses AI to turn audio samples into synth patches, alongside custom wavetables and an expanded effects suite.
items.rationale: A major flagship synth launch with audio-to-preset AI generation that sound designers can use right away. Of the two outlets covering it, this is the announcement article.

items.title: Tracktion Waveform Pro 14.1 Update Adds AI-Assisted Plugin Creation
items.excerpt: With the version 14.1 update, Tracktion Waveform Pro lets users build their own instruments and effects inside the DAW using AI-assisted code generation.
items.rationale: A shipping DAW release that builds AI plugin generation into the host itself. That makes it a concrete new product, not more commentary on the vibe-coded plugin trend.

items.title: Edged Out Records built 'the first costume shop for AI agents'
items.excerpt: Independent label Edged Out Records launched a marketing campaign riffing on Jolly, the plush mascot Meta uses for its Muse AI agent, building a 'costume shop' for AI agents.
items.rationale: A new indie-label campaign built on AI-agent culture. It shows how music marketers are using the agent era as creative material, and it is distinct from the Spotify agent-strategy story from 10-26.

items.title: 음저협 등 6개 음악단체, AI 음악 식별 기술 협상대상자로 '디텍트엑스' 선정
items.excerpt: 국내 주요 음악권리단체 6곳으로 구성된 'K음악권리단체 상생위원회'가 AI 음원 식별 기술 입찰 평가 끝에 디텍트엑스(DetectX v.3.x)를 우선협상대상자로 선정했다.
items.rationale: A concrete deployment decision: six Korean music rights bodies, including KOMCA, picked DetectX v3.x as preferred bidder for industry-wide AI-music identification after a formal tender. That is the operational step behind the AI copyright-registration backlog reported on 10-26.
